details:
I would like a way to disable showing public instances in the UI. Just make them not appear. The join button will never go to a public instance. Portals in worlds go to the same instance type you are in. 

Reason is that family and friends are being more and more separated geographically. Be it by choice, or not by choice due to the political climate. VRChat is an excellent way to connect up. I would love to meet my parents in VRChat and watch a movie, play a game, etc. 

But these people are not tech savy, and don't want to go to public instances with others and deal with the chaos. They just want to join friends. My parents will not tolerate the chaos that goes on in public instances, and the VRC GUI pushes users to join public instances at every step.

What bumped up my request is that a married couple close to me are likely to be separated due to political stuff. Might be for years until the paperwork gets sorted out.  They are not exactly good with tech and didn't know social VR is a thing.  I have some new Quest 3 sitting in right next to me, ready to gift to them if the separation happens. But the accidental join to a public world is a major fear and will likely turn them off the whole experience. 

A way to disable showing public instances and making VRChat a friends/group only experience would be awesome.
title: Option to hide public instances from UI.
